title: Fundraising DAO
tagline: Fundraising app to help people around the world in different situations
description: Decentralized autonomous organization that helps to raise funds from the community in order to help people around the world. Projects have to pass through a voting from the community in order to reach the funding level. Once a project is approved, funding will start. All the funds go directly to the creator of the campain
how_its_made: This project is powered by solidity for governance purpose and funds distribution. All the funds are being sent directly to the creator of the project. Profiles are being created using the lens protocol and those will allow later on to know how many projects has a single account funded. Then we have all the metadata, funding roadmap and profile pictures being stored on IPFS
